operations.content: Soham reads in plain Windows terminal: format structured output as ASCII box tables (+--+ borders, | pipes, = under header), width-checked, short phrases per cell; never markdown tables. Keep language simple, he is a partial/vibe coder.

Standing rules for all setups: verify every server with a live test (tool count alone is not proof, run a real query), separate keys/tokens/logins per agent (never copy secrets between Hermes and Neocoder), 90-day expirations on all tokens, and for Neocoder give end-goals prompts not step-by-step instructions.
